info.about: Yu-Gi-Oh! Dark Duel Stories is a 2000 digital collectible card game of the Yu-Gi-Oh! universe for the Game Boy Color, developed and published by Konami.
info.why: Konami released it in North America in March 2002, after the Game Boy Advance had launched, and the box carried three promo cards that are now traded on their own, so complete copies are scarce.
